source: Compiled from MnDOT trunk highways, Washington County CSAH routes, and high-traffic local arterials in SD 33 / 33A / 33B. Use with official MnDOT traffic maps & county road lists for final siting.
priorityNotes: Highest visibility for yard signs and door density: arterials + feeder streets within 0.25–0.5 mi of polling places.
Never place signs in MnDOT right-of-way without permit; prefer private yards with homeowner permission.
Door knock priority: residential side streets OFF busy corridors (safer, higher contact rate) after seeding signs ON corridor frontage.

corridors.name: MN Highway 36 (Stillwater Blvd corridor)
segments: Hwy 36 / Stillwater Blvd N — Manning Ave (CSAH 15) interchange area
Hwy 36 west approach toward Lake Elmo Ave / CSAH 17
Frontage & parallel residential: Osgood Ave, Curve Crest, Greeley St feeders
corridors.signTip: Yard signs on private property facing Hwy 36 and Manning interchange approaches. Highest daily volume in district.

corridors.name: MN Highway 95 (St. Croix Trail / main Stillwater spine)
segments: S Main St / Hwy 95 through downtown Stillwater
Hwy 95 south toward Bayport / 4th St corridor
Hwy 95 north toward Marine on St. Croix & Scandia
corridors.signTip: Downtown gateway yards and north/south gateways. Pair with door knocks on numbered streets off Main.

corridors.name: County Road 96 / Dellwood Road (former MN 96)
segments: Dellwood Rd N from Ramsey line east to MN 95 (Stillwater)
Junctions with CSAH 15 (Manning), CSAH 5 (Stonebridge), CSAH 11
corridors.signTip: East–west connector between suburbs and Stillwater — prime for signs near junctions.

corridors.name: CSAH 15 — Manning Avenue N
segments: Manning Ave N at Hwy 36 interchange
Manning Ave N toward Stillwater Evangelical Free / polling area (7671 Manning Ave N)
Manning north–south residential feeders
corridors.signTip: Top sign corridor: polling traffic + Hwy 36 traffic combine.

corridors.name: CSAH 5 — Stillwater Blvd / Olive / Owens / Stonebridge Trail
segments: Stillwater Blvd N from Hwy 36 area
Olive St W · Owens St · Stonebridge Trail N toward Hwy 96 / May Twp
corridors.signTip: Local arterial linking south Stillwater to northern townships.

corridors.name: CSAH 12 — busy Stillwater connector
segments: Intersections with Owens St (CSAH 5) and residential collectors

corridors.name: Forest Lake arterials (33A focus)
segments: Lake St S / Broadway corridor (City Center area)
4th St SW near Senior Center polling
Scandia Trail N (near Hosanna Lutheran polling)
Forest Road N (County Service Center / early vote area)
Hwy 61 / Broadway commercial approach (where in district)
Hugo arterial: Frenchman Rd / 140th St corridors (confirm precinct map)
corridors.signTip: Cluster signs on approach roads to each Forest Lake polling site.

corridors.name: Bayport · Marine · Scandia connectors
segments: Hwy 95 through Bayport
Marine on St. Croix main street approaches
Scandia Trail / local CSAH feeders
corridors.signTip: Lower volume but high local trust — doors + sparse high-quality signs at gateways.
